title: Exhausted by Iran War, Tehran Transforms for Khamenei’s Funeral

title: OPEC Plus Pledges to Pump More Even as Oil Prices Fall
partialText: The cartel’s decision comes as U.S.-Iran talks to end the war have eased pressure on oil supplies, even as broader market and political volatility persists.

title: At Trump’s Direction, Federal Agencies Are Abandoning Discrimination Cases
partialText: President Trump has tried to scale back anti-discrimination regulations that date back decades. Federal agencies have heeded his call.

title: Nearly a Million Investors Lost a Total of $3.8 Billion on Trump Crypto Coin

title: America Marks Its 250th Birthday With Storms, Sweat and Fire

title: Years of Warnings About Public Housing Preceded Venezuela’s Earthquakes

title: Mexico’s Secret 12th Man in the World Cup: Baby Jesus

title: Searching for What Pretty Means After an Acid Attack
